Second VERDANT pilot review to assess the first transfer of real hourly data and evaluate a scientific request requiring analysis of 15-minute data without authorizing raw export.

Andrés Beltrán: The hourly transfer completed this morning. Nuria, were there any incidents?
Nuria Castaño: None were critical. The signed policy was verified, temporary codes were applied, and two intervals were suppressed because they represented fewer than three active facilities.
Bruno Silva: We received 2,136 hourly records. Integrity and quality metadata are correct.
Sergio Vidal: The provenance record includes origin, aggregation, suppression and transfer. Automatic deletion is scheduled for 5 August.
Inés Ferrer: I want to submit an additional request. The flexibility model needs 15-minute windows, but it can run inside SolCentro and return daily coefficients by group.
Carmen Rey: We can host the container if the code makes no external calls and we review the results before release.
Héctor Molina: Daily coefficients must group at least five facilities and exclude any individual series or value.
Andrés Beltrán: Will 15-minute data need to be exported at any point?
Inés Ferrer: No. Only the container goes in; aggregated coefficients and error metrics come out.
Andrés Beltrán: The request therefore follows the local-processing route. It does not change the prohibition on exporting raw 15-minute series. Inés will deliver the code on 12 May, and Héctor will review the proposed output.
